description: Where the request text sits on the Anthropic wire, on the third request of the recorded scenario (the scripted model, the recorded runtime; the state trailing, tier off): after two tool calls, get_schema and list_examples, and their results. The system text travels apart, so the person's message is the first message, a text block; each result is a tool_result block in a user turn, and the state joins the last of them as a text block. The rule (budget.json#/$defs/recallQuery) takes the first user turn and its first text part that does not start with STATE_HEADER. Written by hand from the schema, the body abbreviated to its turns; memory/recall.test.ts runs the scenario and holds the third request's turns, the pointer and the text to the item. This harness's (agent#11).

files: packages/harness/engines/vercel/loop.ts (placeState, the run's first user message)
packages/harness/memory/recall.test.ts (the run each item is checked against)
